facts: Wildwood is a 2026 American stop-motion animated epic fantasy film directed by Travis Knight and written by Chris Butler.
With a theatrical runtime of 131 minutes, Wildwood is the longest stop-motion-animated film by run-time.
Wildwood had its world premiere at the BFI London Film Festival on October 11, 2026.
Wildwood is Laika's first film to receive a PG-13 rating from the Motion Picture Association.
